Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Petra Lechner,

Thank you for your quotation and the explanation of the cost drivers. We recognise the genuine pressure from copper and other inputs; our opening proposal rests on our analysis of the overall commercial package.

Our demand forecast for this part has changed +11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09).

The fixed-price options give both sides predictable terms and a clear proposal for your internal approval. We are flexible on payment terms, including an option retaining your quoted payment term; please let us know which package works best.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 350.66 per unit, payment 90 days net, fixed price, no index clause.
Option B: EUR 346.01 per unit, payment 30 days net, fixed price, no index clause.
Option C: EUR 347.16 per unit, payment 45 days net, fixed price, no index clause.

We value our relationship with Nordmark and look forward to your response.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We appreciate the updated demand forecast and have adjusted our pricing to reflect the increased volume. However, the significant rise in copper prices remains a major cost driver that we must account for.

Our Angebot stands at a price of €373.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. As an alternative at standard terms, we propose a price of €369.76 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel, which represents a fair balance of these factors.

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Petra Lechner,

Thank you for verifying our demand forecast and reducing your prices to reflect the growth. We recognise that copper remains a significant cost driver and that a binding volume commitment would give you greater certainty.

We cannot turn the forecast into a binding commitment here, but we have modestly raised our price offer and ask for a further reduction from you in return. Our fixed-price proposal retains your offered extended payment terms without indexation, giving your pricing committee a clear package to assess.

We propose: EUR 352.15 per unit, payment 90 days net, fixed price, no index clause.

We appreciate your constructive response and look forward to an agreement that supports our continuing partnership.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
